selection_method.primary_rule: deterministic round-robin within the 60 highest-count eligible speakers per corpus, after corpus-level frozen filtering
selection_method.permutation: IDENTITY_NO_SHUFFLE; deterministic order is the preregistered allocation order
selection_method.transcript_rule: eligible source must have a non-empty TextGrid interval and matching near-field speaker tier
selection_method.split_rule: session-block assignment to four deterministic 15-speaker split labels; no meeting or speaker crosses split
selection_method.reserve_rule: 20 unused deterministic records per pool, never expanded into primary counts
selection_method.segment_rule: round-to-nearest 16 kHz frame boundaries; parent hash and source offsets retained

source_pools.selection_speaker_ranking: eligible interval count descending, speaker ID ascending; metadata-only
eligible interval count descending, speaker ID ascending; metadata-only
